hits.title: Amtech Systems names Guy Shechter as CEO effective Aug. 13
hits.snippet: © Reuters In this article: ASYS+0.38% TEMPE, Ariz. - Amtech Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:ASYS) announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Guy Shechter as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective August 13, 2026, according to a press release statement. Shechter has also been appointed to the company’s Board of Directors. Bob Daigle, who has served as Chief Executive Officer since 2023 and Non-Executive Chairman since 2022, will transition to the newly created role of Executive Chairman of the Board. Daigle has been a board member since 2021. [...] Shechter joined Amtech in May 2026 as President and Chief Operating Officer. Prior to joining the company, he held leadership positions at Yield Engineering Systems from 2021 to 2026, most recently as Senior Vice President and General Manager. He previously held various leadership roles at Veeco Instruments from 2007 to 2020, including Vice President and General Manager, Global Services Solutions. Shechter holds an MBA and a Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering from Technion - Israel Institute of Technology.
